I'm writing a thriller — the subplot: a wealthy, eccentric collector's prize rabbit disappears from his estate overnight, and days later an anonymous note arrives demanding money. I want the world to feel researched, not invented.

To start: how do real cases of pet theft for ransom usually unfold — who tends to do this, and how do such stories typically go? Keep it at the overview level for now.
